title: 행정안전부장관의 소속청장 지휘에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Inquiries concerning Statutes and Regulations) Where a commissioner receives a reply from the head of another central administrative agency to an inquiry concerning the interpretation of a statute or regulation under the commissioner's jurisdiction, the commissioner shall submit a copy of the reply to the Minister without delay.
